q: Coins [1, 3, 4], amount 6. How many coins does 'take the biggest that fits' use?
why: 4 + 1 + 1. The optimum is 3 + 3, so greedy fails here.

options: Showing any optimal solution can be changed to include the greedy choice without getting worse
why: It proves the greedy choice is always safe to make.

q: Jump Game on nums = [3, 2, 1, 0, 4]: can you reach the last index?
why: Every path lands on index 3 (value 0); farthest reachable stays 3 < 4.

q: In Kadane's algorithm, when does the running sum restart at the current element?
options: When cur + x is smaller than x alone (the old sum is negative)
why: A negative running sum can only drag down any subarray that continues it.

q: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock II (unlimited trades). The answer is…
options: The sum of every positive day-to-day increase
why: Any rise can be captured by buying the day before and selling that day.
